rankingBasis: Complete realized-P&L proxy records (when available) are shown separately from incomplete samples; traders with incomplete/capped samples are ordered by Polymarket period P&L and volume. recordBasis: IMPORTANT: complete profitable/unprofitable close counts are inferred from realized P&L, not verified market prediction wins/losses.
